$comment: Rural QROF tract candidacy for Georgia. Final rural certification is set by Treasury after the state nomination window closes Sept 29 2026 (with a 30-day extension available to Oct 29). New zones become effective Jan 1 2027 for a 10-year designation. This file records the group's target and back-up tracts — Census tract numbers are placeholders to be filled once specific parcels are optioned. DO NOT close any equity into a tract before Treasury certifies the map.

ruralDefinitionStatutory.source: IRC §1400Z-2 as amended by OBBBA (signed July 4, 2025)
ruralDefinitionStatutory.test: Any area OTHER THAN (i) a city or town with population > 50,000, AND (ii) any Census-defined urbanized area contiguous and adjacent to such a city or town.
ruralDefinitionStatutory.consequences: Per-tract test, not per-county. Many tracts that feel rural fail if they sit inside the urbanized-area boundary contiguous to Atlanta / Marietta.
